cause: Training/serving skew on the log transform of f3. Joining the training and serving tables on entity_id, all 200 shared entities match exactly on f1, f2, f4, f5 but differ on f3 in every row. The relationship is exact: training_f3 = log1p(serving_f3) (equivalently serving_f3 = expm1(training_f3)), verified with max error ~6e-7. The training pipeline applies a log1p(x) transform to f3, but the online serving path serves the raw, untransformed value (it skips the log1p step), so the model receives un-logged f3 at inference time.
